Chapter Details: The architecture, governance, functionality and uptake of government data exchange systems. 25 variables in 4 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: Integration of learner records, academic credentials, enrollment data, and scholarship/bursary systems
Comments: No evidence of education system integration with a government data exchange platform in Comoros.
redteam_note: No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Original score of 0 rested only on a general dig.watch country profile with no year recorded. Verification confirms Comoros has no operational government data exchange/interoperability platform: an AfDB project appraisal (2024) and ANADEN's own project updates (2025) show the interoperability and data exchange platform is still being built under the AfDB/IsDB-financed PADEC project, formally launched March 2025, after the national Tier III data centre was inaugurated in May 2025. Since the base exchange layer does not yet exist, no sector integration -- including education -- can exist. Recalculated 0 to 1 (Not integrated), an evidence-based finding rather than a genuine unknown.
revised_comments: Comoros has no operational government data exchange or interoperability platform, so learner records, academic credentials and enrolment data are not integrated into any cross-government system. Digital government development is led by the National Digital Development Agency (ANADEN) under the Comores Numérique 2028 strategy; the planned interoperability and data exchange platform remains under development as part of the AfDB/Islamic Development Bank-financed digitisation project (PADEC), launched in March 2025 following the inauguration of the national Tier III data centre in May 2025.

Definition: Integration of statistics, census data, administrative data for planning, M&E, and evidence-based policymaking
Comments: No evidence of statistical/national planning data integration with a data exchange layer in Comoros. World Bank supports the National Institute of Statistics but no interoperability platform documented.
redteam_note: No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Original score of 0 rested only on a general dig.watch country profile with no year recorded. Verification confirms Comoros has no operational government-wide data exchange platform (AfDB/IsDB-financed PADEC project, launched March 2025, still building the interoperability/data exchange layer). A joint UN SDG Fund programme names INSEED, ANADEN, the Ministry of Health/Social Protection and Customs as partners to establish data-management and exchange protocols for the national statistical system, but this is an early-stage capacity-building initiative, not a documented functioning integration. Recalculated 0 to 1 (Not integrated).
revised_comments: Comoros has no operational cross-government data exchange platform. The National Institute of Statistics and Economic and Demographic Studies (INSEED) is digitising its own statistical systems, including the population census and household surveys, and is a named partner -- alongside ANADEN, the Ministry of Health/Social Protection and Customs -- in a joint UN SDG Fund programme to establish data-management and exchange protocols for the national statistical system. This remains at an early, capacity-building stage rather than a functioning integration of statistics into a government-wide data exchange.
